description_en: Queries the information about the retry log of a Spark application
name: GetSparkAppAttemptLog

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the log.

> You can call the [ListSparkAppAttempts](~~455887~~) operation to query the information about the retry attempts of a Spark application, including the retry log IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
重试日志的ID。
> 调用[ListSparkAppAttempts](~~455887~~)接口查询应用的重试历史信息，包含重试日志ID。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:
